text: The current hierarchy operation fetches well-known folder flags only when no sync token exists. For each batch it removes deleted IDs from the update set and awaits push_sync_state_to_ui before advancing its next-request token. Preserve this order when adding asynchronous folder callbacks. The source proves the operation’s sequencing, not a transaction across every callback or a recovery guarantee after partial UI changes. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Advance EWS hierarchy state after publishing a batch of folder changes
